model: p = galacticToPanorama * icrsToGalactic * icrs; lon = atan2(p.y, p.x), lat = asin(p.z); u = frac(0.5 - lon / 2 pi), v = 0.5 + lat / pi (row 0 of the image is v = 1); then (east, north) = offsetTable(u, v) in texels at the equator and u -= east / (width cos lat), v += (north - yOffsetPx) / height

offsetTable.encoding: uint8 pairs (east, north) per texel, value = (code - bias) / scale texels, row 0 at v = 0 (latitude -90)

fit.measurement: brightest difference-of-Gaussians peak (sigma 1 and 8 px) within 3 px, 5x5 centroid
